why: No major reviewer or authority appears. The results are four paginated copies of one price tracker that mixes HDD and SSD NAS, a LincPlus blog pushing its own N2, an affiliate listicle whose top pick has spinning-disk bays, two unreadable pages, two off-target SSD-drive pages, and one niche specialist (NASCompares) whose mid-2025 general under-$499 list covers two all-SSD units in passing. Nobody filters to silent, all-NVMe units under $500 or measures noise. A focused page comparing the LincStation N2, TerraMaster F4 SSD, Asustor Flashstor 6, youyeetoo NestDisk, UGREEN DXP2800/DH series and similar on bay count, NIC, fan noise and current price with a direct pick would stand out.
